the-cradle

A mother gazes tenderly at her sleeping baby in a cradle under a gauzy, see-through veil. Berthe Morisot painted her sister Edma and her niece. Morisot was a leading Impressionist and the only woman in their first exhibition in 1874. It's one of the most beloved pictures of motherhood.
boyarina-morozova

A noblewoman is dragged through the snowy streets of Moscow on a sled, her chained hand raised with two fingers in a defiant sign. Surikov painted Feodosia Morozova, who was jailed in the 1600s for her faith. The crowd reacts with sorrow, mockery and awe. It's one of the greatest Russian history paintings.
les-orangers

A man and woman sit in a garden at a table, near orange trees in big green tubs. Caillebotte painted the sunlit garden of his family's home. The fresh sunlight and cool shade are lovely. It's a peaceful moment.
the-inquisition-tribunal

A man in a pointed hat is being judged before a court of stern officials, in a dark, gloomy hall. Goya was critical of the Spanish Inquisition, a harsh religious court. He painted it with powerful light and dark. It's a bold statement against injustice.
the-family-of-the-infante-don-luis

A prince and his family are gathered around a card table in a candlelit room, with servants and a painter in the corner. Goya painted himself on the left, almost at the prince's feet. It's a daring and informal royal portrait. It's one of his earliest great family paintings.
the-hanged-man-s-house

A small stone house with a red roof sits at a bend in a country road in Auvers, France. The gloomy title was just a local name for the building. Cézanne painted it with thick, solid strokes. It was shown at the first Impressionist exhibition in 1874.
pandora

A woman in a red robe hugs a golden box as mist and shadowy figures rise from it. In Greek myth, Pandora opens a box and lets out all the troubles of the world, but hope remains inside. Waterhouse painted the moment just before. It's a gripping image of curiosity.
the-magic-circle

A sorceress draws a circle on the ground with a wand, while a raven and a cauldron wait nearby, on a wild, stormy moor. Waterhouse painted a witch casting a spell. The rich colors give it a magical feeling. It's a famous painting of witchcraft.
the-sorceress

A woman in a blue-green dress stands in a rich room, mixing a potion in a pot with a black cat and a bubbling cauldron. Waterhouse painted her intent look. It's a picture of magic at work. It's among his finest.
miravan-breaking-open-the-tomb-of-his-ancestors

A man breaks into a tomb, with his torch, in search of treasure, but finds an inscription that warns him to leave. Wright of Derby painted dramatic lighting inside a gloomy vault. It's based on a story from a popular book. It's a haunting scene.
earthstopper-on-the-banks-of-the-derwent

A man with a lantern and a shovel works by moonlight, blocking fox dens before a hunt. Wright painted a moonlit scene on the Derwent river in England, with a glowing moon behind the clouds. The light is magic. It's an unusual picture of rural work.
the-captive

A man in prison sits with his head in his hands, in a dark cell lit by a single lamp. This is an illustration from a story by Laurence Sterne about a man who is imprisoned. Wright used the light to create a sad, quiet drama. It's a thoughtful work about freedom.
evening-bells

A river sparkles in the pink twilight, with a monastery and wooded banks, as the sound of bells seems to echo. Levitan painted a quiet scene on the Volga in a dreamy light. The soft sky is magical. It's one of the best-loved Russian landscapes.
the-vladimirka

A lonely, wide road stretches across a gloomy plain under a gray sky. The Vladimirka was the road along which prisoners were marched to Siberia. Levitan painted a quiet, sorrowful landscape. It's a landscape with a story of suffering.
isabella-and-the-pot-of-basil

A woman cradles a pot of basil, which holds a sad secret, in a rich red room. The story, from a poem by Keats, is about love and loss. Hunt painted it as a symbol of devotion. It's a famous Pre-Raphaelite painting.
rye-fields

A road winds through tall fields of golden rye, with towering pine trees against a bright sky. Shishkin loved the Russian countryside and painted it in great detail. The rye seems to ripple in the wind. It's a classic Russian landscape.
young-man-at-his-window

A young man in a suit stands with his hands in his pockets, looking down at a Paris boulevard from his balcony, seen from behind. Caillebotte painted his brother René. We can't see what he is looking at, which makes us curious. It's a famous picture of city life.
a-studio-at-les-batignolles

Manet sits at his easel, painting a model, while a group of his friends, including Monet and Renoir, gather to watch. Fantin-Latour painted this tribute to Manet, who was a leader of a new type of art. It's a group portrait of artists. It documents a key moment in art history.
blue-horse-i

A bright blue horse stands in a landscape of red and yellow hills, with its head bent. Franz Marc used blue to represent strength and spirit. He believed animals were closer to nature than humans. It's one of the most famous expressionist paintings.
a-quiet-monastery

A white monastery sits on a green hill by a river, in a golden, quiet light. Levitan loved to paint the Russian landscape with a mood of calm. It's a place that seems out of time. It's a peaceful, spiritual scene.
veronica-veronese

A woman in a green dress plays the violin, in a bright room with a window. Rossetti painted the model Alexa Wilding with a flowing golden hair, as a musician. It's a feast of color. It's a rich portrait of music and beauty.
monna-rosa
A woman holds a fan, with a pink rose behind her ear, her dark eyes distant. Rossetti painted the portrait with deep, rich colors. The title is Italian for 'Lady Rose.' It's an elegant picture.
the-girlhood-of-mary-virgin

A young Mary sits embroidering a lily as her mother, Anne, watches in a quiet room, with a vine outside. Rossetti painted this when he was 20, one of the first Pre-Raphaelite pictures. Every object has a symbolic meaning. It's an early, important work.
girl-with-chrysanthemums

A young girl in a white dress stands in a room, in front of a vase of large flowers, looking out. Olga Boznańska was a Polish painter who worked in Paris. Her soft, gray tones are very special. It's one of the best-known Polish portraits.
springtime

A woman reads in the dappled shade of a lilac tree in bloom, as the spring light falls. Monet painted it in 1872 at Argenteuil with his wife as the model. The pink blossoms and green leaves glow. It's a lovely picture of spring.
symphony-in-white-no-2-the-little-white-girl

A young woman in a white dress leans at a mantelpiece, looking into a mirror, with a Japanese fan and a flower pot. Whistler painted Joanna Hiffernan, as a study in white. He named the picture like music. It's a famous work of the Aesthetic Movement.
the-beloved

A bride, surrounded by attendants, lifts her veil, as a young Black child offers a bouquet of flowers. Rossetti painted this scene inspired by a Bible poem. It's rich with colors and details. It's one of his finest.
cymon-and-iphigenia

A young man wakes in a forest and sees a sleeping girl, and he is changed forever by love. Leighton painted a scene from a story by Boccaccio. The golden light and rich colors are beautiful. It's a lush picture of a magical moment.
starry-night

A calm, blue night with a glowing, shimmering sea and a few stars, and a pair of faint figures on the shore. Munch painted this in 1893, before Van Gogh's version was famous. The swirling blue sky is full of mood. It's a lesser-known night scene.
lady-agnew-of-lochnaw

A woman in a shimmering, silky gown leans back in a chair, with a calm and slightly amused look. Sargent painted Gertrude Agnew, and the picture made him a sensation in London. The fresh and daring style was new. It's one of the most famous portraits of the 1890s.
summer-evening-at-skagen-beach-the-artist-and-his-wife

A couple walks along the beach at dusk, as the sea and the sky glow in tones of blue. Krøyer painted himself and his wife Marie in the soft evening light of northern Denmark. The 'blue hour' of Scandinavia is a magical time. It's a lovely, gentle scene.
view-from-the-artist-s-window

Through an open window, you can see the rooftops and the harbor of Copenhagen, on a sunny day. Martinus Rørbye painted it in a clear and precise way. It's an unusual 'window picture,' which fits inside and outside in one. It's a charming early Danish painting.
madame-de-pompadour

The king's favorite stands in a silky gown covered in bows and flowers, in a garden room with books and a mirror. Boucher painted her as a patron of the arts, with books beside her. She was one of the most powerful women in France. It's a stylish picture.
summer-evening-on-skagen-s-southern-beach

Women in white dresses walk together along the beach in the dusk, with the soft blue sea and sky. Krøyer's friends are the models. The calm, glowing colors are magical. It's a favorite Danish painting.
autumn

A young woman in a fur-trimmed coat and a hat stands in the autumn sunshine, looking at us with a calm expression. Manet painted this near the end of his life. The model was Méry Laurent, a friend. It's a delightful portrait.
congregation-leaving-the-reformed-church-in-nuenen

Villagers in black walk out of a small church after a service, among bare trees. Van Gogh painted it in 1884–85, when his father was the pastor there. The sad dark colors reflect the winter mood. It's a painting of his early life.
kingfisher-by-the-waterside
A bright blue kingfisher sits on a branch beside the water, painted with strokes of color. Van Gogh loved the glowing colors of birds. It's a small, quick study. It's a charming animal portrait.
young-ladies-of-the-village

Three women in fine dresses walk down a country lane, as a cow and a girl stand by. Courbet painted his sisters as the village ladies, giving alms to a peasant girl. The picture was criticized for showing ordinary folks as large as life. It's a landmark of Realism.
at-the-french-windows-the-artist-s-wife
A woman stands by a window, in a quiet room with a calm light, seen from behind. Ring, a Danish painter, painted his wife Sigrid. The picture feels peaceful and still. It's a famous Danish interior.
winter-at-the-sognefjord

A frozen fjord lies below snowy mountains, under a cold, blue-gray sky. J. C. Dahl, a Norwegian painter, painted nature with great accuracy. He was among the first to paint Norway's wild scenery. It's a famous landscape.
midsummer-night-near-vejle-fjord

A twilight scene of a silent fjord, with dark trees and a pale pink sky, as the night sun stays low. Slott-Møller painted the magical light of a northern summer night. The picture is hushed and dreamy. It's a favorite Danish landscape.
germania

A woman in armor stands before the flag of a united Germany, wearing a crown, and holding a sword. Veit painted this in 1848 during a revolution when Germans hoped for a unified country. It hung in Frankfurt's parliament. It's a symbol of national hope.
athenaeum-portrait

George Washington looks out calmly, with a pale background left unfinished. Gilbert Stuart painted this in 1796, and it's the image of Washington on the U.S. one-dollar bill. Stuart never finished it, so he kept it and made copies. It's perhaps the most reproduced portrait in American history.
